watchlist_companies.why: NEW (2026-09-06). Small veteran-founded UAS OEM building the RAIDER 330 (patented Group 3 UAS with Group 4 capability) -- an actual air vehicle, not a satellite/spacecraft program. Open 'Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) and Simulation Engineer' req: owns navigation/autonomy architecture, GPS-denied and contested-environment performance, Simulink required. Highly-technical, high-impact role on what reads as a very small team -- direct match to the quadrotor GNC/Simulink background and no application on file yet.

Full GNC ladder plus a specific 'Flight Control Law Engineer (Internship)' req open now -- junior/senior standing eligible, control laws for autotaxi/autoland/rollout, SIL/HIL testing. Best tooling/domain match found to date (retrofits real aircraft for autonomous operation) and no application on file yet.

One of the 3 tracked boards, but the user has never applied there directly. A 'GNC Engineering Intern (Dallas Metro Area)' req is open now: MATLAB/Simulink/C++/Python, tiered hourly pay by degree level plus a housing stipend -- a direct skills match and the strongest Texas opportunity found.

NEW (2026-09-05). Has both a Summer 2026 and a Summer 2027 'GNC Engineering Intern' req open -- the 2027 cycle lines up exactly with a May 2027 graduation. 6DOF simulation and attitude/orbit control algorithms, direct match to the quadrotor sim background under Dr. Atkins.

NEW (2026-09-05). Open '2026 Summer Internship - GNC Engineering' req: orbital mechanics, spacecraft attitude dynamics, control systems, sequential filtering, MATLAB/Simulink. Fast-growing, well-funded space station startup.

Hypersonic/supersonic airbreathing testbed vehicles. Entry-level 'GNC Engineer I/II' rung plus a GNC Engineering Co-op (Fall 2026) and a GNC Co-op (Spring 2027, $48-62.6K) -- timed for a May 2027 graduation. Explicitly wants MATLAB/Simulink plus C++. Kept on watchlist -- still the best confirmed Boston-region fit despite two follow-up sweeps not finding anything better there.

NEW (2026-09-15). Hybrid-electric eSTOL fixed-wing aircraft; open Flight Controls Engineer and Principal Flight Controls Engineer reqs (fly-by-wire architecture, sim models, control-law verification). ~100-person startup culture despite Lockheed/Honeywell/Safran backing, strong MATLAB/Simulink fit, and it's in DC Metro -- the thinnest tracked region.

skill_gaps_ranked: C/C++ for embedded/real-time flight software -- #1 gap by a wide margin across every GNC/flight-controls posting tracked since 8/28. Resume lists Python/Java, not C/C++.

State estimation / Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF) & sensor fusion -- Shield AI's dedicated State Estimation ladder, Anduril's Navigation & Estimation track and Estimation & Filtering roles all want this explicitly; reconfirmed 2026-09-15 as an explicit requirement on Pivotal's Senior GNC Engineer - Flight Control Verification req.
PX4/ArduPilot autopilot stack -- Auterion, Delta Black Aerospace, Allen Control Systems, Skyways all want hands-on autopilot-stack experience.
Trajectory optimization tooling (GPOPS-II, CasADi, Dymos, IPOPT) -- recurring Anduril preferred qualification.
Simulink-to-C/C++ auto code generation -- bridges directly from existing Simulink skill; probably the fastest of the five to close.
